# castai_gke_cluster_id (Resource)

GKE cluster resource allows connecting an existing GKE cluster to CAST AI.

~> **DEPRECATED** Superseded by `castai_gke_cluster` with the `credentials` block.

## Migration

`castai_gke_cluster_id` registers the cluster and, when `client_service_account` is set, creates
the CAST AI delegate service account that impersonates it. All of that is now expressed
declaratively on `castai_gke_cluster` via `credentials { target_service_account, target_project,
castai_service_account }`.

The CAST AI delegate service account id can be fetched from the `castai_impersonation_service_account`
data source (currently AKS-only, GKE support pending) or from a dedicated CAST AI service account resource.

To migrate an existing cluster managed by both `castai_gke_cluster_id` and `castai_gke_cluster`:

1. Move the cluster state entry to the `castai_gke_cluster` resource:

```shell
terraform state mv castai_gke_cluster_id.cluster_id castai_gke_cluster.this
```

2. Replace the `castai_gke_cluster_id` block and the `credentials_json = "{}"` argument with the
   `credentials` block on `castai_gke_cluster`:

```terraform
resource "castai_gke_cluster" "this" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  location   = module.gke.location
  name       = var.gke_cluster_name

  credentials {
    target_service_account = google_service_account.client.email
    target_project         = var.project_id
    castai_service_account = castai_impersonation_service_account.this.id
  }
}
```

3. `terraform apply` to re-apply the impersonation credentials.

> **CAUTION**: deleting `castai_gke_cluster_id` from the configuration without moving its state first
> archives the cluster. Always use `terraform state mv` before removing the resource block.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) GCP cluster zone in case of zonal or region in case of regional cluster
- `name` (String) GKE cluster name
- `project_id` (String) GCP project id

### Optional

- `cast_service_account` (String) Service account email in cast project
- `client_service_account` (String) Service account email in client project
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `cluster_token` (String, Sensitive) CAST.AI agent cluster token
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `organization_id` (String) CAST AI organization ID
